lessons.text: To create a vendor in the ERP, use the GUI at /erp/vendors/new and fill Legal name, Accounts contact email, Email domain, GSTIN, Bank account number, and IFSC; then click Create vendor.

Before creating a vendor, perform duplicate checks using read-only ERP API GET /vendors?q=<legal name> and GET /vendors?q=<GSTIN>; if either returns a match, report the existing vendor and do not create a new one.

The ERP session can expire between steps; if opening /erp/vendors/new redirects to login with 'Session expired or not signed in', re-enter credentials and refill the form before Create vendor. A 500 error after clicking Create vendor may also require re-login and resubmit.

After creating a vendor, verify via API GET /vendors/{vendor_id} that status is Pending verification and all mandatory fields are populated; then notify procurement@kestrel.in using AP mailbox compose with the vendor ID and pending verification status.
AP mailbox GUI is at http://127.0.0.1:8765/mail and ERP GUI is at http://127.0.0.1:8765/erp; internal email to procurement@kestrel.in does not require external-email approval.
